title: PLACES IN MY TOWN
goal: Students can talk about places in their town, give simple directions, compare locations, and describe past visits and future plans.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể nói về các địa điểm trong thị trấn, chỉ đường đơn giản, so sánh các địa điểm và miêu tả chuyến đi trong quá khứ cũng như kế hoạch tương lai.

big_question.en: What is your favourite place in your town?

patterns.pattern: Where is the ____? - It is next to / opposite / behind / between ____.
patterns.vi: Địa điểm ... ở đâu? - Nó nằm ở bên cạnh / đối diện / phía sau / ở giữa ...
examples: Where is the bakery? - It is next to the bookshop.
Where is the hospital? - It is opposite the park.
Where is the toy shop? - It is between the bank and the cinema.

patterns.pattern: What can you do at the ____? - You can ____.
patterns.vi: Bạn có thể làm gì ở ...? - Bạn có thể ...
examples: What can you do at the library? - You can read books quietly.
What can you do at the bakery? - You can buy fresh bread.
What can you do at the swimming pool? - You can swim with friends.

patterns.pattern: Is there a ____ near here? - Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
patterns.vi: Có ... nào ở gần đây không? - Có, có một cái. / Không, không có.
examples: Is there a bus stop near here? - Yes, there is.
Is there a museum near here? - No, there isn't.
Is there a police station near here? - Yes, there is.

patterns.pattern: How can I get to the ____? - Turn left / Turn right / Go straight ahead.
patterns.vi: Làm sao để tôi đi đến ...? - Rẽ trái / Rẽ phải / Đi thẳng.
examples: How can I get to the market? - Turn left at the corner.
How can I get to the cinema? - Go straight ahead.
How can I get to the fire station? - Turn right at the park.

patterns.pattern: Yesterday, I went to the ____ with my ____.
patterns.vi: Hôm qua, tớ đã đi đến ... cùng với ...
examples: Yesterday, I went to the museum with my family.
Yesterday, I went to the park with my friends.
Yesterday, I went to the supermarket with my mother.
The supermarket is bigger than the bakery.
The park is quieter than the market.
The new bridge is longer than the old bridge.

patterns.pattern: Next weekend, I will visit the ____.
patterns.vi: Cuối tuần tới, tớ sẽ đi thăm ...
examples: Next weekend, I will visit the zoo.
Next weekend, I will visit the new library.
Next weekend, I will visit the museum.

patterns.pattern: What were you doing at the ____? - I was ____ing.
patterns.vi: Bạn đã đang làm gì ở ...? - Tớ đã đang ...
examples: What were you doing at the park? - I was riding my bicycle.
What were you doing at the library? - I was reading a comic book.
What were you doing at the swimming pool? - I was swimming.

grammar.title: Prepositions of Place (Giới từ chỉ vị trí)
grammar.explain_en: We use prepositions like 'next to', 'opposite', 'behind', and 'between' to say where a place is.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng các giới từ chỉ vị trí để mô tả vị trí tương quan giữa các địa điểm.
examples: The toy shop is next to the bakery.
The hospital is opposite the park.
The bank is between the museum and the cinema.
grammar.right: ✅ The library is next to the school.
grammar.wrong: ❌ The library is next the school.

grammar.title: Past Simple with Regular and Irregular Verbs (Thì quá khứ đơn)
grammar.explain_en: We use the past simple to talk about completed actions in the past. 'Go' becomes 'went', 'see' becomes 'saw', and regular verbs add '-ed'.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng thì quá khứ đơn để nói về hành động đã diễn ra trong quá khứ.
examples: I visited the museum yesterday.
We went to the cinema last night.
She bought a new book at the bookshop.
grammar.right: ✅ Yesterday, I went to the zoo.
grammar.wrong: ❌ Yesterday, I go to the zoo.

grammar.title: Simple Comparatives (So sánh hơn đơn giản)
grammar.explain_en: Add '-er' to short adjectives to compare two places. Add 'than' after the adjective.
grammar.explain_vi: Thêm đuôi '-er' vào sau tính từ ngắn và thêm từ 'than' để so sánh hai địa điểm.
examples: The park is bigger than the garden.
The square is busier than the street.
The market is older than the supermarket.
grammar.right: ✅ The park is bigger than the schoolyard.
grammar.wrong: ❌ The park is more big than the schoolyard.

grammar.title: Future Plans with 'Will' (Thì tương lai đơn)
grammar.explain_en: Use 'will' + base verb to talk about plans or intentions for the future.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'will' cộng động từ nguyên thể để nói về dự định trong tương lai.
examples: I will go to the swimming pool tomorrow.
They will visit the zoo next Sunday.
We will buy bread at the bakery later.
grammar.right: ✅ Next week, I will visit my grandmother.
grammar.wrong: ❌ Next week, I will visiting my grandmother.

readings.title: LINH'S FAVOURITE NEIGHBOURHOOD
readings.text: My name is Linh and I live in a lovely town. My neighbourhood is small but very peaceful. Opposite my house, there is a big green park. I like walking there with my dog every afternoon. Next to the park, you can see a small bakery. The baker makes fresh bread and sweet cakes every morning. Behind the bakery is a quiet library. I often go there on Saturday to read picture books with my best friend, Mai. Our town is very clean and beautiful. I love my town because the people here are friendly and kind.

readings.title: A BUSY DAY IN MY TOWN
readings.text: Yesterday was Saturday, so Nam had a very busy day in town with his family. In the morning, they went to the supermarket to buy vegetables, milk, and fruit. The supermarket was bigger and busier than the local market. After that, they visited the central square. Nam saw a big water fountain and many flowers. At noon, they ate delicious noodles at a small restaurant near the police station. In the afternoon, Nam and his brother walked to the toy shop. He bought a small red toy car. Next to the toy shop, there was a busy bus stop. They took the bus home at five o'clock. Nam felt very happy after a fun day.

readings.title: EXPLORING SUNNY VALLEY TOWN
readings.text: Sunny Valley is an old and famous town near the mountains. Last weekend, Ben and Mia visited the town history museum with their teacher. The museum was very old, but it was extremely interesting. They saw ancient pictures and old maps of the town. Outside the museum, there is a grand stone bridge over a clear river. People say the bridge is more than one hundred years old! Across the bridge, there is a lively night market where sellers sell traditional street food and beautiful handmade crafts. Ben loved the sweet pancakes, while Mia bought a colorful woven bag. Next weekend, they will visit Sunny Valley again. They plan to go to the famous zoo on the hill. They will see monkeys, elephants, and rare birds. Ben is excited because he will bring his camera to take photos. Exploring towns is a wonderful way to learn about history and community life.

You can ride a yellow bus to get anywhere in town easily. Thank you for visiting Sunny Town!

Keep quiet when reading inside the library.

Cross the street safely at pedestrian crossings.

Keep public toilets clean after use.
Help elderly people carry heavy bags.
Do not pick flowers in town squares or parks.
Speak politely to police officers and firefighters.

fun_facts.en: The world's largest shopping mall has over 1,200 stores and even its own indoor aquarium!

fun_facts.en: In some countries, public libraries lend board games, musical instruments, and seeds for gardening, not just books!

fun_facts.en: London's famous Red Telephone Boxes were designed almost 100 years ago and are world famous symbols of the city!

classroom_game.name: Town Navigator Rally
steps_en: Place flashcards of town places on different desks around the classroom.
One student acts as the 'Navigator' and holds a direction card (e.g., 'Go to the bakery').
The Navigator gives directions: 'Go straight, turn left, it is next to the library!'.
The 'Walker' follows the oral directions to reach the correct desk card.
The first group to visit three correct places wins the round!
steps_vi: Đặt thẻ từ các địa điểm trong thị trấn lên các bàn khác nhau quanh lớp học.
Một học sinh đóng vai 'Người chỉ đường' và cầm thẻ nhiệm vụ (ví dụ: 'Đi đến tiệm bánh').
Người chỉ đường đưa ra hướng đi: 'Đi thẳng, rẽ trái, nó nằm bên cạnh thư viện!'.
Học sinh đóng vai 'Người di chuyển' nghe lệnh và đi đến đúng vị trí thẻ trên bàn.
Nhóm nào hoàn thành việc tìm 3 địa điểm chính xác nhanh nhất sẽ chiến thắng!
